summary.en: Short songs and DIY labels reset the bar; post-punk rebuilds with bass, space, and art-school rigor.
summary.zh: 短歌与 DIY 厂牌重置门槛；后朋克用贝斯、空间感与艺术学院手法重建。

sound.en: Fast downstrokes, dry snare, cold basslines, early drum machines
sound.zh: 快速下拨、干军鼓、冷贝斯线、早期鼓机

body.en:
Punk is not short metal. From ~1976 in New York and London it cuts song length, rejects virtuoso solos, and favors cheap gear and independent labels. Post-punk keeps the urgency but adds space, funk/reggae rhythm, synths, and art-school arrangement.

On this chronicle the era sits apart from metal: same years, different scenes, different production goals.
body.zh:
朋克不是短金属。约 1976 年起，纽约与伦敦把歌曲缩短，拒绝炫技 Solo，偏向廉价器材与独立厂牌。后朋克保留紧迫感，但加入空间感、Funk/Reggae 节奏、合成器与艺术学院式编曲。

在本编年史里，这个年代与金属分开：同一年份，不同场景，不同制作目标。
